	[34090] = { cast = 1000, cd = 14000, desc = "Shoots a wave of force up to |nc;20m|r in front of you. 	[34093] = { desc = "Teleport to a random location #{buff_tooltip} away.\nNo cooldown. Spend Abyssal Charges to cast repeatedly.\nCan't be used while Snared.", icon = "icon_skill_hatred24.png", line = "Sorcery", maxr = 4, name = "Void Leap" },
	[34094] = { buffs = { { bad = true, desc = "Inflicts #{total_min_damage}-#{total_max_damage} Magic damage for 11sec, ignoring Magic Defense.", dur = 11000, icon = "icon_skill_hatred36.png", name = "Deadly Poison", tick = 500 } }, cd = 14000, desc = "Throws venomous knives at all enemies within a #{buff_tooltip2} radius, dealing an initial #{avg_damage}#{detail_melee_damage} Physical Damage and inficting the Deadly Poison debuff. #{buff_tooltip}", icon = "icon_skill_hatred27.png", line = "Shadowplay", maxr = 4, name = "Venom Blades" },
	[34095] = { cd = 16000, desc = "Ends all ongoing Perform skills, but creates #{buff_tooltip}diminished echoes of those abilities as buffs for up to |nc;10 seconds|r. }
